name: Bournemouth cervical quantitative fluoroscopy (BORDaR 385)
what: 252 lateral flexion and extension sequences from 63 people at 15 fps, 1024 x 1024 16-bit DICOM; the deposit holds the per-frame vertebral corner tracks (.mat, 24 MB) and no pixels
level_truth: level-named corner tracks C0 to T1 on every frame (geometry only until the cine arrives)
licence: CC BY 4.0 (the tracks); README.rtf CC BY-ND
how_to_get: Send request 1 of spine-program 01_carm_level_detection/docs/data_requests/FLUORO_VIDEO_REQUESTS_READY_2026-09-26.md (01_bournemouth.eml), citing doi:10.18746/bmth.data.00000385 and doi:10.3390/jfmk9010055, asking for the anonymised 16-bit DICOM keyed to the .mat event ids.
The same letter asks Professor Breen for the lumbar cine (below).
